Tidy a SimtablR result

Source: R/render.R
tidy.simtab_result.Rd

Tidy a SimtablR result

Usage

# S3 method for class 'simtab_result'
tidy(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'simtab_spec'
tidy(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A simtab_result or simtab_spec.

...

Ignored.

Value

A long data.frame. For table1, this matches as.data.frame(x, tidy = TRUE).

Examples

res <- tb(epitabl, sex, diabetes)
generics::tidy(res)
#>   variable  level estimate lower_ci upper_ci p_value outcome
#> 1      sex Female       NA       NA       NA      NA      No
#> 2      sex   Male       NA       NA       NA      NA      No
#> 3      sex Female       NA       NA       NA      NA     Yes
#> 4      sex   Male       NA       NA       NA      NA     Yes
